slide_title: Apply Convolution as a NEW MODULE

bullets: Essentially a dot product, similar to linear layer
labels: Since Convolution is a DOT product (between filter values and corresponding image values),
It can be applied as if it is a NN Layer
Input: image values, Weights : filter values, Activation: Linear, Bias:0
Remember: for training, it is required to have the gradient of Output w.r.t both Input and weights

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (largest, bold serif, two-color). Boxed statement text is next in size; the three display equations are the visual focal point of the lower half; legend and callout labels are smallest. Red borders and the yellow starburst draw the eye to key content.

visual_elements.description: White rectangle with medium blue border containing three lines: 'Since Convolution is a DOT product (between filter values and corresponding image values),' / 'It can be applied as if it is a NN Layer' / 'Input: image values, Weights : filter values, Activation: Linear, Bias:0' with Input, Weights, Activation, Bias in bold

White rectangle with red border containing red italic serif text: 'Remember: for training, it is required to have the gradient of Output w.r.t both Input and weights' ('Remember:' bold; text wraps with 'weights' alone on line 2)

Small legend box, light-cyan fill with blue border, 4 lines each 'symbol ⇒ meaning': θ_ij ⇒ Filter weights; r, c ⇒ row, column; a_rc ⇒ Activation value = Σ; θ ⇒ Vevtor of all weights (symbols bold dark-red, meanings black; 'Vevtor' typo preserved)

Large red-bordered white panel containing three open-circle-bulleted items with display math: (1) 'Activation function' followed by a_{r,c} = Σ_{i=-a}^{a} Σ_{j=-b}^{b} x_{r-i,c-j} · θ_{ij}; (2) 'Essentially a dot product, similar to linear layer' followed by a_{r,c} ~ x^T_{region} · θ; (3) 'Gradient w.r.t. the parameters' followed by ∂a_{r,c}/∂θ_{i,j} = Σ_{r=0}^{N-2a} Σ_{c=0}^{N-2b} x_{r-i,c-j}

Two thin red annotation arrows with solid arrowheads: one from the 'Weights: filter values' callout pointing up-left to the θ_{ij} term of the first equation; one from the 'Input: pixel values' callout pointing left to the x_{r-i,c-j} term of the gradient equation
visual_elements.position: between right-edge callouts and equation panel

colors.body_text: #1A1A6E (dark navy in definition box); #C00000 (Remember box); #000000 (legend meanings, equations, callout suffixes)

typography_notes: Serif (Times New Roman-like) throughout. Title ~36–40pt bold, two-color (red + blue), 'NEW MODULE' in all caps and underlined. Body ~18–20pt; key terms (Input, Weights, Activation, Bias, Remember, Weights, Input) bold. Remember box is entirely italic red. Legend symbols bold dark-red with subscripts (θ_ij, a_rc). Equations in serif math with subscripts/superscripts and large summation signs with limits above/below. Bullets in the equation panel are small open circles. Callout labels mix bold blue lead word with black regular text.
